pictures.note: Not fetchable as a single plate: the only official image (cdn.maryland.gov .../2026-01/Gold-Star-Plates.png, 601x155) shows both Gold Star plates side by side, so it fails the shape check (the runner saw 500x129 for the webp style). Left = Lapel Button (gold star on purple), right = Next of Kin (gold button). The MVA bulletin and Military & Veteran plates pages carry no separate images, and the old stg-mva gold-star page is gone. Needs a person to crop, or leave the stand-in.
